assumeRoleARN.description: Backend-only. Mirrors the upstream awsds struct tag so the schema stays in sync. Use aws_sdk_settings.assumeRoleArn instead: the editor only writes that spelling, and the backend reads either because encoding/json matches the key case-insensitively.

assumeRoleArn.description: Optional. Specifying the ARN of a role will ensure that the selected authentication provider is used to assume the role rather than the credentials directly.

authType.description: Specify which AWS credentials chain to use.

customMetricsNamespaces.description: Comma-separated list of custom CloudWatch metric namespaces to offer in addition to the built-in AWS namespaces.

defaultLogGroups.description: Deprecated: use logGroups. Previous storage shape, an array of log group names. The config editor clears it when logGroups is saved.

defaultRegion.description: Specify the region, such as for US West (Oregon) use `us-west-2` as the region.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route requests to this data source through Grafana's Secure Socks Proxy, which backs Private Data source Connect (PDC). Only shown in the editor, and only takes effect, when the Grafana instance has the secure socks data source proxy configured.

endpoint.description: Optionally, specify a custom endpoint for the service

externalId.description: If you are assuming a role in another account, that has been created with an external ID, specify the external ID here.

grafanaExternalId.description: Per-datasource external ID used for Grafana Assume Role. Only takes effect when "Use per-datasource external ID" is enabled; otherwise the stack-wide external ID is used.

logGroups.description: Optionally, default log groups for CloudWatch Logs queries. Written and read by the config editor and query editor only; the backend does not read it from the data source settings.

logsTimeout.description: Grafana polls for CloudWatch Logs results every second until a Done status is returned from AWS or this timeout is exceeded, in which case an error is returned. For alerting, the timeout from the Grafana config file takes precedence. Must be a valid duration string such as "30m", "30s" or "2000ms". Empty or zero uses the default of 30 minutes.

profile.description: Credentials profile name, as specified in ~/.aws/credentials, leave blank for default.

proxyType.description: Specify the type of proxy to use. This should not be set if Secure Socks Proxy is enabled.

proxyUrl.description: Proxy URL. Don't set the username or password here

proxyUsername.description: Optional: Proxy Username. This functionality should only be used with legacy web sites. RFC 2396 warns that interpreting Userinfo this way "is NOT RECOMMENDED, because the passing of authentication information in clear text (such as URI) has proven to be a security risk in almost every case where it has been used."

region.description: Backend-only. Read by the AWS SDK settings loader; when empty or set to the default region marker it falls back to defaultRegion. The config editor never writes it; use defaultRegion.

tracingDatasourceUid.description: UID of the Application Signals data source containing traces, used to create trace links from logs. Frontend-only.

usePerDatasourceExternalId.description: Grafana Assume Role only. When enabled, this datasource uses its own external ID (below) instead of the stack-wide external ID.

secureValues.description: Optional: Proxy Password. This functionality should only be used with legacy web sites. RFC 2396 warns that interpreting Userinfo this way "is NOT RECOMMENDED, because the passing of authentication information in clear text (such as URI) has proven to be a security risk in almost every case where it has been used."
